correctness.rationale: All 2^18 arc subsets and an independent DFS enumerator agree on 687 augmented faces. A 326-pair complete face-poset matching is acyclic over 2256 Hasse incidences, leaving critical-cell vector (1,0,5,22,6). Exact integral Morse projection yields zero remaining differential. Five integral 2-cocycles and six exact rational 4-cycles determine 90 vanishing Alexander–Whitney cup evaluations. Since H_4 and H^4 are torsion-free, these kill all 15 Hopf/Whitehead components of the six 4-cell attaching maps. The 4-to-3 differential already kills the remaining 3-sphere map components; thus the full wedge equivalence follows. Direct mod 2 and mod 101 homology ranks are independent consistency checks; no infinite inference rests on finite testing.

value.rationale: The triangular prism is the unique nonbipartite connected cubic graph on six vertices, a canonical triangular/rectangular cyclic trivalent graph. Its fully bidirected multipath complex is a natural reference example in topological digraph combinatorics. The exact mixed-dimensional integral wedge, including nullity of Hopf/Whitehead 4-cell attachments, is substantially stronger than a routine field-rank enumeration and supplies a meaningful comparator to previously studied polygons, trees and bipartite cubic graphs.
